name: Layout Clone
description: Copy repeated-circuit placement and project-local footprint edits with explicit PCB selection. English and Turkish UI.
description_full: Layout Clone has separate Placement and Footprint Edits tabs. Copy anchor-relative placements or project-local pad geometry and footprint graphics to explicitly selected PCB targets. Preserve target identity, placement, schematic linkage and pad nets. Includes previews, opt-in similarity suggestions, English/Turkish UI and native undo. Pad edits require matching unique numbered pads and unambiguous paste apertures; graphics-only edits preserve pads without matching them; opposite-side targets receive a KiCad-compatible geometry reflection and layer conversion. No library or schematic changes; no auto-save. Windows / KiCad 10.0 testing release. Close other PCB and schematic editors before applying. See the bundled usage notes.
